summary: All 51 frames read with body.mjs, driven in the app, captured headlessly and diffed twice: a layout signature (sig prefix v-sos-, plus v-sos-a2- for the hub with a live urge session seeded and v-sos-a3- for the hub reached through its own door) and a pixel diff of the PNGs with the status bar (y<54) and home-indicator band (y>=834) excluded. 48 of 51 were reached; the three D038 boards were not. 44 frames are genuinely clean — mean |Δ| at or under 0.19/255 with no structural row missing — including all three grid pickers (0.000), SOS Challenge (0.000), SOS Reassess (0.000), SOS Afterward (0.000, so the TextInput placeholder the report said "the probe cannot read" does in fact draw pixel-identically), Cue Intro Modal, Cue Hue Picker (0.000 once the Expo dev badge is masked) and 25 of the 27 reachable response boards. Four genuine defects survive, none of them a D015 equivalence. In severity order: (1) convex/events.ts's create mutation was never given the durationSeconds argument this group added to the schema and to TidelineEvent, and the interrupt now sends it — on a real Convex backend the argument validator rejects the call and the .catch(()=>{}) at the call site swallows it, so no urge_rode_out event is written at all; the identical earlier change (severityAfter, D041) WAS added to the mutation. (2) Surf Complete's sun states rx/ry and no r, so the web build paints it at r=50% instead of the canvas's 86% and the rim reads 30/255 too dark — the report attributes this to FINDINGS F8, which is superseded by D064/F12/F22, and the same file's sibling in src/app/relapse.tsx:406 already carries the correct form and measures Δ<=8. (3) SosSceneLayer's elliptic branch reads only the first vertical radius and always emits Hill, so SOS Feel Low's candle flame — border-radius 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%, rounded at both ends — is drawn with a square bottom, Δ145/255. (4) A blurred SOLID pill is substituted by a SoftBlob whose falloff dies at the box edge, collapsing a 100x16 warm bar into a small lens: Δ28-31 on SOS Loc Private Room and SOS Feel Stressed, Δ17-26 on the three move boards and Relapse Twice. D082 already states the correct treatment for exactly this and it has not been applied here; D010 covers only soft-edged radials, so this is not a standing equivalence. The urge hub itself is sound: with a live session seeded (2:18 old, severity 7) every pane matches band by band at max Δ3 outside the marker (D067), the dot-grid data and the digits, the wash survives being pushed from /(app)/all so F20 does not bite here, "Try a different step" wraps 1->2->3->1 as D068 says, and the Breathe pill hands over and comes back. Capture note for other agents: the Expo dev-tools floating badge lands at x 0-64, y 788-852 in some app captures and produced a false Δ217 on Surf Step 1 and Δ75 on Cue Hue Picker before I masked it; and --seed on /relapse timed out at networkidle twice under load where --initseed worked. Tools left at .vicifull/vtmp/ (pxdiff.mjs, pxband.mjs, sample.mjs, crop.mjs, v-hub-seed.js).

findings.frame: Surf Complete (and every urge_rode_out the interrupt writes)
findings.design: the field exists in convex/schema.ts:153 (durationSeconds: v.optional(v.number())) and in TidelineEvent (src/lib/types.ts:156), and 85C/85D are read out in minutes from it (D070)
findings.app: convex/events.ts's `create` declares no durationSeconds arg and does not insert it; src/lib/backend/convex.ts:202 spreads the whole TidelineEventInput into the mutation, so Convex raises ArgumentValidationError and the call site's .catch(()=>{}) hides it — the ride-out event is not written at all on a real account
findings.note: HIGH. Not visual, and invisible to every capture in this run because EXPO_PUBLIC_FORCE_MOCK=1 routes through src/lib/backend/mock.ts, which stores the object verbatim. The precedent is in the same file: severityAfter and reopens (D041) were added to the mutation's args and to the insert when they were added to the schema. Fix is two lines: durationSeconds: v.optional(v.number()) in args, durationSeconds: args.durationSeconds in the insert. Until then 85C's twelve bars and 85D's four rows are permanently empty on Convex and the whole interrupt logs nothing.

Black ground shadows (rgba(0,0,0,0.10)) show the same shape error at Δ<=17 because they are lower contrast. Marked "likely" rather than "certain" only because a run could reasonably decide the substitution is close enough; it is visibly different in the crops.
